title: The Lair Mouth
text: The quarry's lair is a cave mouth in the hillside, littered with the bones of hunters who came before. They still wear their rotting leathers, their purses still at their belts. The air coming out of the cave is warm and smells of meat.

options.label: Smoke it out of the lair and meet it in the open, where you can see it.

outcomes.text: It comes out angry and blind with smoke. You are ready.

options.label: The Leader goes in after it, into the dark among the bones.

outcomes.text: It knows every stone of its own den in the dark. Going in was brave and foolish, and it will be remembered.

options.label: The quickest loots the dead hunters first; they will not mind.

outcomes.text: They pull a good bow from a dead hand. Behind them, the quarry wakes.
